items.headline: UEFA Announces FIFA World Cup Boycott Over Controversial Private Equity Investment Plan
items.summary: On July 30, UEFA announced an unprecedented boycott of all FIFA competitions, including future World Cups, following an emergency vote by its 55 member nations. European football leaders rejected FIFA President Gianni Infantino's proposal to sell a minority stake in World Cup commercial rights to private equity investors.

items.headline: Producer Sues Netflix for $105 Million Over Stolen Nicolas Cage Film Copy
items.summary: Filmmaker Simon Afram filed a $105 million lawsuit against Netflix after an unencrypted master copy of his unreleased World War II movie starring Nicolas Cage was stolen from the streamer's Los Angeles office. The lawsuit claims the physical theft ruined the film's commercial value due to piracy risks, while Netflix argues it is not responsible for materials submitted without standard digital safeguards.
